name: PT Garda Tujuh Buana Tbk
summary: PT Garda Tujuh Buana Tbk engages in mining, producing, and selling thermal coal in the north middle part of Bunyu Island, Indonesia. The company engages in construction and trading activities. It is also involved in logistics operations. In addition, it exports its coal products. It serves coal fired power plants. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
